description.text: Objective This objective is to train students to develop morally, intellectually and physically to meet the requirements of the socioeconomic development in the 21st century. After graduation, students should have solid professional foundation, wide-range knowledge, strong ability and innovative spirit; have high accomplishments of mathematics and economics; obtain the basic theories and methods of statistics; and skillfully use computer to analyze data. Students can work in enterprises or economic management departments at all levels for a various pursuits in the fields of statistic survey and consultation, information management, data analysis, application and management. Or students can also serve as teachers in schools, or as research staff or actuaries in research institutions. Core courses Mathematical Analysis, Analytic Geometry, Advanced Algebra, Probability and Statistics, Different Equations, Numerical Methods and Computer Technology, Introduction of Economics, Applied Regression Analysis, Statistics, Finance, Insurance Mathematics, Sampling Survey, Stochastic Processes, Nonparametric Estimation, Multivariate Statistical Analysis, Economical Risk Analysis, Measure Theory, Time Series Analysis, Humanities and Social Sciences. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Science is granted.

duration.text: The Statistics at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
